title: Write unit tests for the report module
prompt: shoplib/report.py has no tests. Write thorough unittest tests for it in tests/test_report.py, covering `summarize`, `format_summary` and `stock_report`: cancelled orders, discounts and tax in revenue, top-product ranking and ties, `top_n`, empty input, low-stock flagging at the threshold boundary, and the exact output format. The tests must pass against the current code and should catch regressions in it.
